name: mongodb
description: Pointer-only preset for projects using the MongoDB Node.js driver. Surfaces the canonical MongoDB skill suite (`mongodb/agent-skills`, Apache-2.0) at install time on projects whose `package.json` contains `"mongodb":` (as a direct dependency, anchored on the JSON key terminator to disambiguate from `mongodb-memory-server`, `@types/mongodb`, `mongodb-runner`, etc.). MongoDB Inc. is independent (no vendor-neutrality concern). The ODM layer (`mongoose`) is intentionally NOT covered here — a hypothetical follow-up `mongoose` preset can ship later per the strict 1-entry detect rule (EF-005). See `docs/recipes/recommended-vendor-skills.md` §MongoDB and `specs/presets-vendor-pointer-tier/spec.md` for the tier semantics.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Canonical MongoDB skill suite from MongoDB Inc., covering schema design heuristics, indexing strategies, query patterns, and operational safeguards. Verified via `gh api repos/mongodb/agent-skills` on 2026-05-19 — 114★, last commit 2026-05-18, Apache-2.0, not archived. Pair with claude-base's `ops-database` skill (stack-neutral conventions: naming, soft-delete, updated_at triggers).

outOfScope: Foundation skill curation — no `foundation.skills.keep/drop` filter (vendor-pointer tier)
Opinionated install-time defaults — inherited from foundation defaults
Mongoose ODM (`mongoose`) — distinct dependency, not auto-detected here per the strict 1-entry detect rule (EF-005); a hypothetical follow-up `mongoose` preset can ship later
Dev-only MongoDB utilities (`mongodb-memory-server`, `mongodb-runner`, `@types/mongodb`) — not the driver itself; these would surface as false positives without the colon-anchored substring used here
Non-Node MongoDB stacks (Python `pymongo`, Go driver, Java driver) — out of this preset's scope
